about: Her default body (lane G flip, the owner 16-17 Nov). default: p1 = body B, a = the shipped body A (the fallback: set a, or pass --body a). hidden_on_b: callings not offered on B, and a character of one of them loads on A (the owner 17 Nov: 'hide all 3 besides warden for demo'); empty the list to bring them back. outfits_hidden_on_b: on B, an equipped item's pieces from these outfits are not drawn (her calling's own piece shows in that slot; the item's stats are unchanged), so the demo's kit (the Prologue's and the dev veteran's padded jerkin wears ranger.top) dresses her in the Warden set only; A is untouched; empty the list to bring them back. dir = her body's published folder (P1Body.PickDir; tools/body/publish_house.py writes it); absent = body_p1; pass `--p1-dir res://art/people/body_p1/` to show B for side by side.
